3 finding(s): 1 to fix, 2 to consider; 3 on their lines. Reply in a comment's thread to answer it.

### Summary

This PR changes the reconcile dialog from two tables to four collapsible groups, one per outcome (renamed, added to the library, set aside, left as they are). It also adds a safety note, result tiles and hint lines in the banner. The kind-to-group mapping matches the scanner: every kind's `fixable` flag in vault-reconcile.ts is constant, so grouping by kind lines up with `fixableCount`. One thing to fix: the new intro sentence says a scan has finished and describes a Fix all plan, but the dialog also shows it while scanning, on errors, when busy and when everything matches. Two smaller suggestions: the \"gone\" group's header copy and a test whose name promises more than it checks.
